C0784.title: Trivy Supply Chain Attack: Malicious Binaries Distributed via Official Channel
C0784.summary: Attackers compromised Trivy's official distribution channel and released a tampered v0.69.4 binary. The malicious payload is a credential-stealing trojan that collects environment variables, cloud tokens, SSH keys, and CI/CD secrets from all CI/CD pipelines running Trivy scans.
